verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a GitHub/GitLab integration that links pull requests to related items (monday-intdir-2), and makes a generic claim of '2-way sync between monday products and any platform' (monday-docs-31). Nothing shows bi-directional syncing of tasks with a repository's issue tracker: PR linking is one-way context, and the 2-way sync claim is not specific to code-repo issue trackers. missing for 10: documented bi-directional GitHub/GitLab issue sync (field/status mapping, conflict handling), evidence that issues rather than just PRs sync, hands-on or independent corroboration.
